articles.summary:
An empty reader is a hard place to start. If you already know which sites you want to follow, adding them is straightforward. But if you’re trying RSS for the first time, finding those first few feeds is part of the work. I wanted NewsBlur to help with that, right inside the app.

I’ve rebuilt the first-time experience on iOS and Android around exploring interests, previewing feeds, and choosing what goes into your reader. You can put together a few folders of things you care about, or ...
articles.title: A new first-time experience on iOS and Android: find your first feeds

articles.summary: Hi, posts from the feed below appear in NB as raw HTML instead of rendered/formatted text. Sample text as it appears in NB: <_cdata> Rede social do presidente de El Salvador ajuda a construir apoio emocional a um projeto de poder que enfraquece instituições democráticas <media:content url=“ https://nexo-uploads-beta.s3.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/images/2026/10/Nayib_Bukele__53255806513_74a0ec1f35_o\_-600x400.webp ” type=“image/webp” medium=“image”> media:title Nayib Bukele em fotografia de 2023 </media:title> media:credit Casa Presidencial El Salvador / Wikimedia Commons </media:credit> </media:content> Nos últimos anos, El Salvador se tornou um caso emblemático de como redes sociais podem ser usadas para reforçar projetos políticos de caráter autocrático. Desde 2019, o presidente Nayib Bukele consolidou um poder sem precedentes no país, enfraquecendo contrapesos institucionais, ampliando o estado de exceção e militarizando a vida pública. Apesar das críticas de organizações internacionais, seu governo mantém níveis de aprovação extraordinariamente altos. I assume it’s a problem with the feed itself, but maybe there’s a way NB can workaround the issue?

articles.summary:
I spent a lot of this release optimizing speed in the Android app. I measured scrolling across the feed list, the story list, and long articles, then fixed whatever the numbers pointed at. Then I kept going.

It’s faster Most of the slowness came from the app doing more work than it needed to. Marking a story read rebuilt its entire row. Background syncs could pile up on top of each other. The feed list waited on the sync service before showing anything, and the reader waited for the ar...
articles.title: NewsBlur 15 for Android: faster scrolling, a tablet layout, and Add + Discover Sites

articles.summary:
I spent a lot of this release optimizing speed in the iOS app. Opening a big folder took over a second, scrolling would hitch whenever the next page of stories loaded, and articles flashed blank for a moment before appearing. So I measured every part of the story list and the reader, then fixed whatever the numbers pointed at.

Faster story lists Loading the next page of a folder used to reload the entire list. Now new stories are added in place. Favicons, thumbnails, and story text get...
articles.title: NewsBlur 15 for iOS and Mac: faster story lists, a glass toolbar, and Add + Discover Sites
